evidence.text: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
But their minds were closed. For to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. It has not been lifted, because only in Christ can it be removed.

matchReviews.senseReview: Original article identifies Christ as the title of Jesus. Exact capitalized Christ is matched; plural or lower-case false christs is not automatically included.

evidence.text: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,
We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.
And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
